title: Validate a registration form
description: Validate username, email, password, and confirmPassword. Username must contain only ASCII letters, digits, and underscores and be 3 to 20 characters. Email must contain one non-whitespace local part, an @, and a dotted non-whitespace domain. Password must be at least 8 characters and contain at least one letter and one digit. confirmPassword must equal password. Return valid true with an empty errors object only when every rule passes; otherwise return valid false and one message per failed field.
signature: export function validateRegistrationForm(input: { username?: unknown; email?: unknown; password?: unknown; confirmPassword?: unknown }): { valid: boolean; errors: Record<string, string> }
